design.excluded: 4 cells exceeded the reasoning budget; affected headlines averaged over remaining seeds so every mode retains 200 matched pairs

released_artifacts.scored_eval: eval/seed_avg_paired_qwen27b.json (raw protocol); the normalized-protocol eval is seed_avg_paired.json in this directory

scoring.test: one paired Wilcoxon signed-rank per (mode, metric) over 200 seed-averaged headline pairs, delta = human - model

provenance: Generated on a rented 2x A40 pod with bench/gen_vllm.py; raw generations and the compiled eval released on the dataset; normalized scoring is canonical.

normalization.why: generation hygiene flagged 89% title lines in control docs, markdown scaffolding the plain-prose human baseline lacks. Scoring input = normalized text (echoed headline block dropped, markdown unwrapped, all prose preserved).
normalization.raw_text_scoring: archived in-repo at seed_avg_paired.raw-archive.json (raw text, same metric); the dataset carries the raw-protocol eval.

cost_usd: not recorded (rented GPU time, same lane as Gemma 3 27B)
